title: Corpus Explorer — React web workbench over the chunk database

questions.prompt: How should the web app be served?
questions.description: The repo already has a token-guarded FastAPI server (`notebooklm-server`, `server` extra) with /v1 routes. The SPA source would live in `web/` at repo root.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Mount the built SPA on the existing FastAPI server at /ui and add /v1/corpus/* routes. One process, one token, and Vite dev-server proxy during development.

options.label: Built SPA served by existing notebooklm-server at /ui + new /v1/corpus routes
Separate standalone backend process just for the explorer
Vite dev server only (no production build/serving)

questions.recommendedAnswer: Vite + React + TypeScript, Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives), TanStack Query for server state, TanStack Table + Virtual for large chunk lists, Motion for animation, cmdk for a command palette.

options.label: Vite + React + TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + TanStack Query/Table
Vite + React + TS + Mantine
Next.js (separate Node server)

questions.prompt: Which features are in scope for the first full release?
questions.description: You said 'featureful'. Pick everything that must ship; unpicked items become explicitly out of scope.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All of search, browser, detail, delete, RAG answer, similar-chunks, topic/embedding map, run dashboard, bulk actions, export, command palette.

options.label: Hybrid RRF search with per-leg score breakdown (keyword rank, vector rank, fused score) and query-term highlighting
Chunk browser: virtualized table filterable by notebook, document, run, topic, fact-check status, length
Chunk detail pane: parent context with child highlighted, neighbor sentences, spaCy tokens/entities, SFL features
Delete chunks (single + bulk), logged to removal_log
RAG answer: streaming LLM answer over retrieved chunks with inline citations linking to chunks
Correlate: 'more like this' nearest-neighbor chunks by embedding distance
Correlate: 2D embedding scatter (UMAP/PCA) colored by topic/document, click to open chunk
Ingestion run dashboard: chunk_runs stats, live progress while ingestion runs
Multi-select bulk actions (delete, export, re-fact-check)
Export selected chunks to Markdown/JSON or push as a NotebookLM note
Cmd-K command palette and full keyboard navigation (j/k, /, etc.)
Also a Rich TUI 'Corpus' mode in flerp style (same _app logic)

questions.prompt: What should delete do, and at what granularity?
questions.description: Memory notes say the Postgres DB is disposable/low-rigor. removal_log already exists as an audit table.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Hard delete with cascade to embeddings/fact_checks, write a removal_log row per delete, and support clause, parent chunk, and whole document/run granularity. Undo via a short toast window (delay commit ~5s) rather than soft-delete columns.

options.label: Hard delete + cascade + removal_log row
Soft delete (hidden flag, restorable)
Granularity: single clause (child chunk)
Granularity: parent chunk with its children
Granularity: whole document or ingestion run
Undo toast (delayed commit) instead of confirm dialogs

questions.recommendedAnswer: Reuse the assessment router's configured model (DSPy/litellm, env NOTEBOOKLM_ASSESSMENT_* — Ollama by default), bound per request via dspy.context, streamed to the browser over SSE. Langfuse tracing as already configured.

options.label: Existing assessment router model (Ollama default), streamed via SSE
Send retrieved chunks to NotebookLM chat.ask instead
Model picker in the UI (any litellm model)

questions.description: 'Needs to look real good.' This sets the design language the build follows.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Dense data-workbench look (Linear/Raycast-like): dark-first with a light theme, three-pane layout (filters | results | detail), monospace for chunk text metadata, accent colors taken from the existing TUI theme so both surfaces feel related.

options.label: Dense dark-first workbench, 3-pane, TUI-theme accents, light mode too
Airy editorial/reading-focused layout
Terminal-retro aesthetic mirroring flerp/the TUI

questions.prompt: How live should the view be while ingestion is running?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Poll counts/run stats every 5s (TanStack Query refetchInterval) with a 'N new chunks' pill that refreshes results on click; SSE only for RAG streaming.

options.label: 5s polling + 'N new chunks' pill
Server-sent events push for everything
Manual refresh only

questions.recommendedAnswer: pytest for every /v1/corpus route against the real Postgres (fail hard if unreachable), Vitest + Testing Library for components, and a Playwright smoke test that searches, opens a chunk, and deletes one.

options.label: pytest route tests against real Postgres
Vitest component tests
Playwright end-to-end smoke flow
Manual verification is enough
